description.en: More on the HUD: rounds left in the magazine, a health bar under each player's card, health bars over enemies, damage numbers, and a reload circle and an ammo circle beside the Helldiver. Each part is an option here and a row on the pause menu's Mods page, and a change in one place shows in the other.
Rounds left in the magazine, over the magazine count, for weapons that fire rounds. Hidden while calling a stratagem.
A red bar under each player card, with a white chunk fading where health was lost and a yellow bar over it while a shield holds.
Current and maximum health at the left of each player bar.
A bar over every enemy the player hits and every heavy that any player hurts. The bar of an enemy out of view waits at the edge of the screen.
A ring to the left of each local Helldiver that fills while the weapon in hand reloads.

A yellow ring beside each local Helldiver with the share of the magazine left, a segment for each round (for each group of rounds past 30), red below a tenth. Lasers fill the ring with heat, red past nine tenths, and arc weapons show it in blue. Empty, the ring flashes red, with the reload button inside for weapons that fire rounds. Shows from a shot, hides after a reload, and fades out 8 seconds after the last shot.
Takes away the game's own red bar over each Helldiver.
Takes away the game's own bar over a downed Helldiver getting back up.
The damage dealt, where it lands: on enemies the player hits, on players losing health, or both.

Stacked shows a number for each hit, rising out of the way at once. Accumulated adds every hit on one target into one number that stays in place and fades out, and a new one starts only once it is gone.
Above health bar needs Enemy health bars, and uses the entity spot where no bar shows. At damage instance uses the spot each hit landed.
